# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_trmm_data_is_current, bcm_fpot_data_is_current

# Freshness of the load-time setup data. Every pass writes its stamp only where it completes, so a
# save taken mid-pass reads false and redoes it, and a load finding every stamp current does no
# setup work at all. The other two stamps live with their own features:
# bcm_building_classification_is_current (bcm_building_triggers.txt) and
# bcm_pf_river_data_is_current (bcm_map_mode_triggers.txt).

# No scope. Recommended Urban Rights coverage, which bcm_trmm_recompute_province_definition stores on
# every province slice. Synchronous, so there is no in-flight state to guard against.
bcm_trmm_data_is_current = {
	has_global_variable = bcm_trmm_stamp
	global_var:bcm_trmm_stamp = bcm_trmm_version_value
}

# No scope. The per-location food potential scores, written by bcm_fpot_recompute_all.
bcm_fpot_data_is_current = {
	has_global_variable = bcm_fpot_stamp
	global_var:bcm_fpot_stamp = bcm_fpot_version_value
}
